summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K updating the execution of the third tranche of its own-share buyback program, disclosing share repurchases made between June 1 and June 5, 2026. The company, through manager Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG, bought 7,820,054 shares at weighted-average prices from €19.57 to €19.98, totaling cash outlay of €602.4 million, representing 41.26% of the tranche's maximum cash amount. The repurchases were executed on the Spanish continuous market (XMAD) with no activity on other venues. No board recommendation or advisor beyond the manager is named. The filing updates cumulative versus remaining program capacity. This is a routine open-market buyback disclosure; the special situation is capital return to shareholders.
